+- Give it a full doc comment in the style of the `RoutedSession` protocol methods: what it constrains, what it returns, what it throws.
+- Add it to the DocC page that covers guided generation.
+- Confirm `JSONValue`'s public members are complete enough for a consumer to read a result: case access or accessors, `Codable`, `Equatable`. Add what a consumer needs; add nothing more.
+

+- [ ] The doc comment and DocC page describe the method.
+

+- [ ] Add `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/GuidedPublicSurfaceTests.swift` with a plain `import FoundationModelsRouter` (no `@testable`), so the compiler itself proves the surface is public.
+- [ ] In that file, call `respond(to:matching:)` against the scripted fixtures and assert on the returned `JSONValue`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #router #api
